name: localization
description: Serves the interface messages of every installed module and holds the default culture of the deployment and of each tenant.

settings.name: Localization.DefaultCulture
settings.description: The culture used when a request names none that has messages. A BCP 47 tag, for example en or cs. The tenant value overrides the global one.

operations.description: The messages of every installed module for a culture, with the culture fallback already applied. Public.
